ntscc_selection: User approved released NTSCC+; NTSCC++ online inference is unreleased

training.sqgan_channel_policy: Train the unchanged codec stages once; evaluate real discrete payloads over both documented digital transports. Not native channel-aware training.
training.preprocessing: Preserve each author's released augmentation; document DIV2K dataset substitution
training.precision: Author-compatible FP32 unless separately validated and disclosed
training.incomplete_epoch_policy: Save sampler cursor and RNG state; never count or silently skip incomplete epochs

evaluation.rate_policy: Measured rate-quality curves; no ranking of unmatched actual channel budgets
evaluation.common_awgn: Per-example unit mean complex-symbol energy; circular CN(0,10^(-snr_db/10)) additive noise
evaluation.common_rayleigh: One independent CN(0,1) gain per image/codeword; complex AWGN; perfect receiver CSI and equalization; no clipping of deep fades
evaluation.geometry: Native full image first; model-specific documented padding; remove only padding for scoring; no resize or silent crop
evaluation.side_information: Count every communicated stream; serialize if digital; disclose modulation/FEC mapping
evaluation.flops: FMA=2; include actual forward/backward and all optimizer updates; disclose unsupported operators and partial totals
evaluation.ranking_gate: Never rank different realized rates, fading scopes, receiver CSI, or incomplete FLOP coverage as identical experiments

budget.policy: Measure warmed-up steps first; include evaluation/setup; do not shorten epochs, reduce data, replace architecture, or invent results to fit quota
